name: Daily Snake
author: Addicting Games
description: Daily Snake is your daily dose of brain-teasing puzzles. It’s true that you should work out to train your body but you shouldn’t forget about your brain. You should challenge your brain every day by solving puzzles. You don’t have to solve an overly difficult puzzle if you’re not in the mood. Choose from 4 different levels of difficulty: 6X6, 8X8, 10X10, and 12X12. Your objective is simple but the execution will require time and thought. Using only your limited amount of tiles as well as the hints on the board, connect the head of the snake to its tail. If you get stuck, you can either undo the last move or clear out the board and start over.
